title: Prospects for the Protective Mechanisms and Compounds of Bufei Huoxue Capsule against COVID-19 Convalescence: Evaluation of Integrating UHPLC-HRMS Analysis and Network Pharmacology Strategy.
authors: Xie, Yi-Zi; Xie, Yi; Liu, Cheng-Xin; Peng, Chen-Wen; Lin, Xue-Ying; Huang, Hui-Ting; Zhan, Shao-Feng; Liu, Xiao-Hong; Li, Hang; Huang, Xiu-Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文用UHPLC-HRMS和网络药理学研究补肺活血胶囊对COVID-19恢复期的保护机制，虽含分子对接和转录因子分析，但核心是药物-靶点-通路网络，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Most COVID-19 survivors are troubled with chronic persistent symptoms, which have currently no definitive treatments. Bufei Huoxue (BFHX) capsule exerts clinical benefit, while the material basis and molecular mechanism remain unclear. AIM: The study aimed to elucidate the protective mechanisms of BFHX capsule against COVID-19 convalescence. METHODS: UHPLC-HRMS and various databases were employed to explore potential compounds and targets. PPI, MCODE, transcription factor (TF), and miRNA analyses were conducted to receive hub targets and corresponding upstream regulators. Molecular docking was applied to verify the binding activity of compound and target. Further, GO, KEGG, WIKI, and Reactome analyses were performed, and compound-target-symptom and gene-disease networks were constructed. RESULTS: A total of 127 compounds and 313 targets were acquired. A sum of 10 hub targets were screened and molecular docking results suggested that the top 3 compounds had good binding affinities with the top 3 target proteins. MLLT1, CBFB, and EZH2 were identified as key TFs, and hsamir- 146a-5p, hsa-mir-26b-5p, and hsa-mir-24-3p were predicted to be important miRNAs. BFHX capsule may alleviate the symptoms by targeting TNF, IL-6, IFNG, and TGF-beta1. Besides, BFHX capsule may exert a therapeutic effect on respiratory disease (especially pulmonary fibrosis and lung infection) and multi-system damage during COVID-19 convalescence by regulating cytokinecytokine receptor interaction, as well as TGF-beta, TNF, and Toll-like receptor signaling pathways. CONCLUSION: In summary, BFHX capsule may exert a therapeutic effect on multi-system damages during COVID-19 convalescence through multiple compounds (such as albiflorin, isopsoralen, and neobavaisoflavone), multiple targets (such as TNF, IL-6, and EGF) and multiple pathways (TGF-beta, TNF, and Toll-like receptor signaling pathways).
abstract_zh: 引言：大多数COVID-19幸存者受到慢性持续性症状的困扰，目前尚无确切治疗方法。补肺活血（BFHX）胶囊显示出临床益处，但其物质基础和分子机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在阐明BFHX胶囊对COVID-19恢复期的保护机制。方法：采用UHPLC-HRMS和多种数据库探索潜在化合物和靶点。通过PPI、MCODE、转录因子（TF）和miRNA分析获得核心靶点及相应的上游调控因子。应用分子对接验证化合物与靶点的结合活性。进一步进行GO、KEGG、WIKI和Reactome分析，并构建化合物-靶点-症状和基因-疾病网络。结果：共获得127种化合物和313个靶点。筛选出10个核心靶点，分子对接结果表明前3种化合物与前3种靶蛋白具有良好的结合亲和力。MLLT1、CBFB和EZH2被鉴定为关键转录因子，hsa-mir-146a-5p、hsa-mir-26b-5p和hsa-mir-24-3p被预测为重要miRNA。BFHX胶囊可能通过靶向TNF、IL-6、IFNG和TGF-beta1缓解症状。此外，BFHX胶囊可能通过调节细胞因子-细胞因子受体相互作用以及TGF-beta、TNF和Toll样受体信号通路，对COVID-19恢复期的呼吸系统疾病（尤其是肺纤维化和肺部感染）和多系统损伤发挥治疗作用。结论：总之，BFHX胶囊可能通过多种化合物（如芍药苷、异补骨脂素和新补骨脂异黄酮）、多个靶点（如TNF、IL-6和EGF）以及多条通路（TGF-beta、TNF和Toll样受体信号通路）对COVID-19恢复期的多系统损伤发挥治疗作用。
